summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 25% YoY to INR5,651 million, but organic constant-currency growth was only 5% after excluding the North American real estate contract.
summary.overview: Revenue reached INR5,651 million, up 25% YoY, helped by MST and SweetRush acquisitions; constant-currency growth was 11.4% YoY and 2.9% QoQ. Ex-acquisitions growth was 11% YoY, and organic constant-currency growth was 5% after normalising for the North American real estate (RECO) contract that ended in FY26. EBITDA was INR1,032 million (18.3% margin), up 8.5% YoY, and PAT was INR574 million, up 16.4% YoY. Management kept FY27 guidance of high single-digit revenue growth and an 18–20% EBITDA margin, and guided Q2 to 9–11% YoY growth with margins around 18%.

Overall CC growth normalised for RECO: ~18%
vs INR205 million QoQ and INR181 million YoY
vs 65 days QoQ and 68 days YoY

segments.name: Industrials
segments.commentary: About 20% of revenue, grew 35% YoY, partly driven by MST joining the group.

segments.name: Technology & Telecom
segments.commentary: About 23% of revenue (largest sector), grew only 8% YoY; hit by two large clients cutting L&D budgets in the prior quarter, which have grown sequentially but not yet returned to last year's run rate.

segments.name: Management consulting & professional services
segments.commentary: About 9% of revenue, declined 16% YoY, affected by the same two client budget cuts.

segments.name: MST Group (acquired July 2025, Germany/DACH)
segments.commentary: Contributed approximately INR231 million to Q1 revenue; managed learning provider focused on automotive, industrial and energy clients.

segments.name: SweetRush (acquired January 2026, US/Costa Rica)
segments.commentary: Contributed approximately INR431 million to Q1 revenue; AI-enabled, immersive (AR/VR/XR) and strategic learning provider.

segments.name: AI-enabled services
segments.commentary: Contributed 13% of Q1 FY27 revenue; includes solutions with embedded AI and engagements where the AI studio and tools are part of delivery. AI-ready L&D Enterprise portfolio launched in June.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at high single digits.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 18% to 20%, reflecting delivery discipline and phased margin build in SweetRush; management said this is unchanged from last quarter.
Q2 FY27 guidance: 9% to 11% YoY revenue growth with EBITDA margin around 18%.
Management expects QoQ growth to dampen in Q2 (European summer vacation quarter), revive in Q3, and flatten in Q4.
Management said some recent wins could accelerate growth but would talk about it only once more certain.
Long-term margin expectation of about 20% at overall level as the business scales.
capex_capacity: Capex was INR144 million in Q1 FY27.
Significant ongoing investment in AI and AI-related infrastructure build-out, cited as a major use of capital.
Management is actively evaluating acquisitions; three acquisitions completed in the past 12 months with more in the pipeline.
Investor Day planned in Mumbai, tentatively around 10 September 2026, to showcase AI-led initiatives.
demand_pricing: Three new long-term annuity contracts signed in Q1, taking the annuity client count to 113 from 95 a year earlier. New clients included a quantum computing company, a global clinical research organisation and a global hospitality company.
Expanded scope with one of the world's largest professional services firms; three renewals completed (two global pharma companies and one large US bank).
Revenue visibility USD462 million, up 19% YoY and only slightly up QoQ; management said it is net of revenue consumed and new order intake.
Top-5 client revenue share rose from 31% to 35% QoQ, attributed to a large client added in Q4.
Management cited cautious client decision-making and macro uncertainty affecting timing of new ramp-ups.
AI-enabled subscription-style revenue: a client with about 12,000 users consuming AI content, coaching and simulation services; margin profile said to be better than company average.
